# NFL Daily — 2026-10-20 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Eagles QB Jalen Hurts' superficial blood clots turned into a season-ending situation; he is done for 2026 and undergoing treatment. [NYT Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7705552/2026/10/19/jalen-hurts-eagles-superficial-blood-clots-situation/)
- The NFL will not discipline the Eagles for clearing Hurts to keep playing with the blood clot. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50230816/reports-nfl-punish-eagles-jalen-hurts-situation)
- Commanders WR Terry McLaurin tore his patellar tendon on Monday Night Football and is out for the season. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50230371/commanders-wr-terry-mclaurin-torn-patellar-tendon)
- Colts fired GM Chris Ballard, raising questions about a broader front-office overhaul. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50218623/colts-fire-gm-chris-ballard-shane-steichen)
- Rams WR Davante Adams will miss 6-10 weeks after rupturing his hamstring and undergoing surgery. [NYT Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7705718/2026/10/19/davante-adams-hamstring-injury-out-weeks/)
- 49ers WR Mike Evans was ruled out of Monday night's win with an Achilles injury. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/is-mike-evans-playing-monday-night-football/)
- The NFL is increasing security for Sunday's Steelers-Saints game in Paris after civil unrest in France and says the game will proceed as scheduled. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50230791/nfl-increase-security-paris-steelers-saints-game)

## Transactions
- Giants released RB Najee Harris, days after he criticized the team's running-back rotation. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/giants-release-najee-harris-critical-of-coaching/)
- Rams signed veteran K Brandon McManus after K Blake Grupe was lost for the season. [Ian Rapoport](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2112642419405787363)

## Injuries
- Ravens QB Lamar Jackson is questionable for Week 7; the team says his ankle is day-to-day. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/jesse-minter-lamar-jackson-ankle-still-day-day-monday-week-7-injuries-rashod-bateman-cam-jurgens-trey-hendrickson-tyler-loop-critical-misses)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-10-20 (Past 1 day)

## Key news
- Ravens blew a double-digit lead and lost to the Browns, their latest collapse in what's become a season-long pattern of blown big leads. [Jamison Hensley (ESPN)](https://x.com/jamisonhensley/status/2112541225219723412)
- Ravens re-signed K Jake Moody to the practice squad after Tyler Loop missed two field goals over the last three games, setting up a kicking competition. [Jamison Hensley (ESPN)](https://x.com/jamisonhensley/status/2112638688417185862)
- Baltimore County Council approved a lease extension keeping the Ravens at their stadium through 2038. [Baltimore Sun](https://www.baltimoresun.com/2026/10/20/baltimore-ravens-deal-baltimore-county/)
